name: Cory Morgan (formerly Cory Cochiolo)
reason: Work is mainly therapy sold on conditions: her own site (ajnahypnotherapy.com, 5 Nov 2026) offers hypnotherapy, counselling, talk therapy and couples therapy after a consultation 'before any treatment plan', framed around stress, anxiety, phobias and healing, plus a hypnotherapy training programme; one of her two books is sold on helping children get to sleep.
